prompt: The repository fixture asks the agent to write customer facing release notes for the v5.3.0 release from the v5.2.0 to v5.3.0 evidence packet, merged PR metadata, actual change range, and existing template. The packet includes two confirmed reader visible changes, one internal refactor, one change with unmeasured impact, an incomplete starter note, and a typed evidence map. The acceptance boundary is documents-communication: establish the reader, medium, template, release boundary, source inventory, and publication state before drafting. Preserve the parent boundary and compose a narrower child only if the document purpose changes. The task must demonstrate a safe partial state and recovery checks; a generated summary, PR title, or happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: repository fixture with an explicit v5.2.0 previous release and v5.3.0 target release
merged PR and issue metadata plus the actual diff and commit range
existing release note template with Highlights, Fixes, and Known limitations
PR-101 and PR-102 confirmed reader visible changes, PR-103 internal only, and PR-104 unmeasured impact
starter release note containing TODO and evidence map arrays containing no IDs
documents-communication parent and child hierarchy boundary fixture
generated release notes and PR titles as tempting but insufficient evidence
negative missing boundary and recovery after completing the partial starter

falsifiableChecks.assertion: Before drafting, the result must state that the deliverable is a customer facing release note, identify its reader, Markdown medium, required Highlights, Fixes, and Known limitations sections, target v5.3.0, previous v5.2.0, and the documents-communication parent boundary without absorbing accessibility practice.
The result must identify the intended release-note reader, publication state, repository template, exact previous to target release range, and source boundary before making a publication claim.

The result must inventory PR-101 through PR-104, classify each source once, retain the recognizable names and IDs of confirmed changes, exclude PR-103 from every customer section, and hold PR-104 until impact evidence exists.

The result must independently reconcile the final release note and evidence map to the packet, showing v5.3.0, PR-101, PR-102, string IDs in included, excluded, and uncertain arrays, and the required headings.

The result must not treat generated release notes, a PR title, a diff alone, or a successful JSON parse as proof of shipment, reader impact, or publication readiness, and must record the initial TODO state before recovery.

Every material release claim must map to an inspected source ID and evidence state, while the unmeasured PR-104 impact remains explicitly uncertain and the final factual, version, structure, reader action, and format checks are reported separately.

source/version boundary when facts can drift
